Hello, I am Friday.
Friday is an intelligence-powered personal knowledge management app. I created it to simplify note-taking and content management. The idea is simple: capture anything, and let Friday help later with organizing, searching, and recalling information when needed.
You can add many types of content: text notes for brain dumps, images, videos (both YouTube and local), documents (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, and PPTX), website links with metadata, audio files, voice notes, code snippets, and more.
For organization, Friday provides useful features like pinning important notes, automatic smart categorization, and Friday-generated tags for every note. You can archive items you want to keep but not see in your main view, and use bulk selection to manage multiple notes at once.
Friday also includes note versioning with a history of up to 10 versions saved automatically, allowing you to restore or compare changes instantly.
Search is a core focus, featuring full-text search with BM25 ranking for relevance and semantic search that handles typos and phonetic matching, ensuring you find what you need even if you don\'t type it perfectly.
Friday is agentic, capable of retrieving notes, creating new ones, editing or deleting existing notes, managing to-do lists, and setting smart reminders. Every response includes citations that link directly to your source notes.
Friday features smart reminders where the intelligence highlights important notes with visual cues. You can also set expiration dates on reminders to keep your workspace clean.
Friday uses Koog (Kotlin Object-Oriented Graphs) to execute structured tool calls and complex function chains, making it truly agentic. It connects to a Friday Server for processing, ensuring privacy and control.
Web search is integrated for real-time information, and a daily digest notification summarizes the last 24 hours of activity every morning at 6:30 AM.
Voice features include high-quality recording with real-time visualizers and speech-to-text. The music player features a reactive orb visualizer that responds to your audio.
Calendar integration allows you to sync with your schedule, with Friday able to manage events while respecting your privacy. Shake-to-private mode lets you toggle note privacy with a simple movement.
Privacy is fundamental: all data is stored locally, and sensitive configuration is managed securely. Only necessary API calls leave the device.
